title: Swamp Thing #74 DC Comics July 1988 Rick Veitch Alfredo Alcala Kaluta Cover
condition_description: Toned covers, chipping along the bottom edge and lower-left front corner, light creases on the back. See photos.
description:
Swamp Thing #74 (DC Comics, July 1988), 2nd series. Written by Rick Veitch, art by Alfredo Alcala, cover by Michael Kaluta. Suggested for Mature Readers. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Batman: The Cult ad (Starlin/Wrightson).

Condition: toned covers with chipping along the bottom edge and lower-left front corner, and light creasing on the back cover (see close-ups).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
